items.result: 100% auditable payroll and elimination of legal risk before the Comptroller's Office.
items.description: The official SISPER system (MEF) was rigid and forced payroll to be recalculated externally in Excel, losing traceability. anvynt developed SISRH, a transactional engine that replaces that fragile process, automates complex financial calculations, and integrates attendance control with full auditing.
items.metaTitle: 100% Auditable Payroll for the Public Sector | anvynt Case Study
items.metaDescription: How anvynt replaced INDECI's manual Excel payroll recalculation with SISRH, a transactional engine that automates payroll and removes the risk before the Comptroller's Office.
items.resumenSolucion: Transactional payroll engine with full auditing and traceability.

enfoque.objetivo: Replace manual Excel recalculation —which caused loss of traceability and legal exposure before the Comptroller's Office— with a reliable, 100% auditable transactional engine.
acciones: Assessed the payroll process and the calculation rules the official SISPER system didn't cover.
Designed a proprietary transactional calculation engine, independent of the MEF's rigid system.
Integrated attendance control as the single data source for wage calculations.
Added a full audit trail for every payroll movement.

solucion.texto: anvynt developed SISRH, a system that centralizes INDECI's payroll calculation and management in a single transactional engine, eliminating external spreadsheets and the inconsistencies that process caused.

capacidades.descripcion: Automates complex payroll financial calculations, replacing manual Excel recalculation.
Joins attendance records with wage calculation in a single flow, with no manual steps in between.
Every calculation and movement is logged and traceable, ready for Comptroller's Office review.

impacto.texto: The new system transformed INDECI's payroll management, leaving behind a fragile process with no traceability.
beneficios: 100% auditable payroll, removing the legal risk before the Comptroller's Office.
End of manual Excel recalculation and the traceability loss it caused.
Complex financial calculations automated end to end.
Attendance control and payroll integrated into a single flow.

items.result: 100% auditable platform with smart validations and full information traceability.
items.description: Data collection and consolidation processes were carried out manually, generating inconsistencies and making institutional analysis difficult. anvynt developed FEPMA Verifica, a web system that automates data capture, incorporates validation rules and dynamic forms, ensures integrity control and traceability for every record, and exports solid, consistent information ready for data analysis and the generation of statistical indicators for national management and oversight.
items.metaTitle: Data Automation for the Ombudsman's Office | anvynt Case Study
items.metaDescription: FEPMA Verifica: the platform anvynt built to automate the capture, validation, and traceability of the Ombudsman's Office's institutional data.
items.resumenSolucion: Data capture and validation platform with full traceability per record.

enfoque.objetivo: Replace manual, inconsistency-prone information collection with a system that captures, validates, and consolidates data automatically and traceably.
acciones: Mapped the manual data collection and consolidation processes in place.
Designed dynamic forms adapted to the institution's different record types.
Defined validation rules to guarantee the integrity of every captured record.
Built an export module ready for data analysis and statistical indicators.

solucion.texto: anvynt developed FEPMA Verifica, a web system that automates data capture and applies smart validations to every record, delivering solid information ready for national oversight.

capacidades.descripcion: Dynamic forms that replace manual collection and reduce the margin for error.
Validation and integrity rules applied at the moment of capture, not after the fact.
Every record is linked to its origin and history, available for audit.

impacto.texto: FEPMA Verifica changed how the Ombudsman's Office collects and analyzes its institutional information.
beneficios: 100% auditable platform, with full traceability for every record.
Smart validations that remove inconsistencies at the data's source.
Information ready for data analysis and statistical indicator generation.
Direct support for national-level management and oversight.

items.result: 100% digitization of the SERVIR evaluation cycle and automated generation of official reports.
items.description: Performance evaluations required by the SERVIR Law were managed in isolated Word and Excel files, with no deadline control. anvynt developed a Performance Management System (GDR) that digitizes the entire annual cycle, automates the GDR PDF report, and applies access control based on 8 regulatory roles.
items.metaTitle: Digitizing SERVIR Evaluations for Defense | anvynt Case Study
items.metaDescription: anvynt fully digitized the SERVIR performance evaluation cycle for the Armed Forces Procurement Agency, with automated PDF reporting.
items.resumenSolucion: Digitized the SERVIR performance evaluation cycle with role-based access control.

enfoque.objetivo: Digitize the annual performance evaluation cycle required by the SERVIR Law, until now scattered across Word and Excel files with no deadline control.
acciones: Assessed the SERVIR evaluation cycle and the regulatory roles involved.
Designed a single digital flow to replace the isolated Word and Excel files.
Automated the generation of the official GDR report as a PDF.
Implemented access control based on 8 distinct regulatory roles.

solucion.texto: anvynt developed the Performance Management System (GDR), which digitizes the full annual performance evaluation cycle for the Armed Forces Procurement Agency.

capacidades.descripcion: The full annual SERVIR cycle moves from isolated documents to a single digital flow with deadline control.
The GDR report is generated as a PDF automatically, ready for official submission.
8 distinct regulatory roles, each with permissions tailored to its function within the evaluation cycle.

impacto.texto: GDR turned a process scattered across Word and Excel into a digital, traceable evaluation cycle compliant with SERVIR regulations.
beneficios: 100% digitization of the SERVIR evaluation cycle.
Automated generation of official PDF reports.
Access control based on 8 regulatory roles.
End of isolated, deadline-uncontrolled Word and Excel files.
